final_judgment.single_storyline: Causal interventions can leave natural representational support; harm is claim-dependent, null-space changes may be harmless, hidden/dormant pathways provide pernicious cases, and CL offers a geometry-level mitigation proxy. [PDF p.6 §4.1, 'harm is inherently claim dependent', interpretation; p.8 §5, 'minimizing divergence magnitude', interpretation]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: The main body keeps Figure 2 cross-method divergence, Section 4 exact failure constructions, and Figure 3 CL/OOD outcomes—the objects needed to decide whether the diagnostic and mitigation deserve attention. [PDF p.5 Figure 2, 'not specific to any one method', interpretation; p.10 Figure 3, 'higher OOD performance', interpretation]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Proofs, sample/layer selection, metrics, training recipes, parameter sweeps, and full regression diagnostics move to the appendix; prevalence and robustness judgments depend on those pages. [PDF p.15 A.1.1, 'selected layer 10', interpretation; p.21 A.6, 'Covariance Type nonrobust', interpretation]
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 plus the two minimal circuits implements a visual-intuition → exact-construction → practical-implication chain that turns an off-manifold warning into a falsifiable mechanism. [PDF p.2 Figure 1, 'functional landscape', interpretation; p.8 §4.2.2, 'hidden context dependencies', interpretation]
final_judgment.largest_gap: CL optimizes EMD/IIA without testing hidden-path activation or dormant flips, and the paper states that modified CL is not specific to pernicious divergence; the mitigation mechanism remains open. [PDF p.10 §6, 'not specific to pernicious divergence', interpretation]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: Define representation-level harm relative to a downstream function and scientific claim, then pair an existence construction with a real-model measurement to separate can-happen from does-happen. [PDF p.7 §4.1, 'specific mechanistic claims', interpretation; p.5 §3.2, 'in practice', interpretation]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: The rule applies when interventions may leave natural support and output success does not identify an internal mechanism; it matters less for work claiming only input-output control. [PDF p.6 §4.1, 'harmless to the overall matrix multiplication', interpretation]
